observation: Live www.hotels.com returns HTTP 429 with DataDome-style bot challenge page titled 'Bot or Not?' ('Show us your human side...') to curl, headless Chrome (Playwright channel=chrome), across www., uk. hosts and sister brand expedia.com
interpretation: Expedia Group edge applies IP/bot scoring (captcha-delivery.com assets observed in network log = DataDome). Direct runtime exploration of the live target is BLOCKED from this network; no bypass attempted.
open_questions: Would residential/network change restore access? Not pursued (rate-limit/bot-wall evasion out of scope)

observation: Archived homepage renders full marketing shell: hero search widget ('Where to next?'), utility nav (Cars, Deals, Vacation rentals, Groups & meetings, Gift Cards, Magazine, One Key credit cards), header actions (USD currency picker, List your property, Support, Trips, Sign in), promo carousel ('Members save up to 20%', free cancellation, side-by-side compare), and category chip carousels (castles, resorts, ocean view...)
interpretation: Home is a search-first landing page with merchandising carousels; discovery chips feed pre-parameterized searches.

observation: Search results page exposes full filter taxonomy via fieldsets: popularFilter, amenities, paymentType ('Reserve now, pay later','Reserve without a credit card','Pay with Hotels.com gift card'), propertyCancellation ('Fully refundable property'), lodging (property type), accessibility, travelerType (Eco-certified, LGBTQ welcoming, Business friendly, Family friendly), mealPlan (Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner/All inclusive), rewards (VIP Access, member perks, Member Prices instant savings of 10%). Sort options: Recommended, Price low->high, Price high->low, plus rating/distance variants; 'How our sort order works' disclosure present. Result count '118 properties'; 'Compare properties' tool; map trigger present.
interpretation: Filtering/sorting is a first-class P0 surface; merchandising levers (VIP Access, Member Prices) are embedded as filters, meaning loyalty state influences result rendering.

observation: Client bundles served from travel-assets.com/CDN include graphql.js plus feature bundles named blossom-lodging-search-form, shared-ui-lodging-property-search, shared-ui-lodging-property-listing, shared-ui-retail-sort-and-filter-lodging, shared-ui-retail-lodging-compare, shared-ui-lodging-property-details, shared-ui-lodging-reviews, shared-ui-retail-lodging-fee-inclusive-pricing-coachmark; React hook naming observed (useOptimizeLodgingSearchLoadTimeExperiment); module federation-style shared-ui packages
interpretation: Web frontend is a React-based PWA composed of shared, independently published UI modules consuming a GraphQL experience layer — consistent with Expedia Group's published Experience API/SDUI architecture. Bundle families: lotus-home-ui (home), blossom-flex-ui/blossom-lodging-*, shopping-pwa (search).
open_questions: Exact endpoint path of GraphQL gateway

observation: Sign-in page: email-first form (loginFormEmailInput + submit), 'Sign in with Google or Email', 'Other ways to sign in', copy states 'one account across Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo'; redirect parameter pattern /login?uurl=e3id=redr&rurl=<return-url>; /trips redirects anonymous users to sign-in with rurl preserved
interpretation: Unified 'One Identity' account with OAuth-style return URL flow; trips/bookings are member-gated resources.
open_questions: Session cookie/token mechanics unobservable without login

observation: One Key program page: OneKeyCash earned on eligible spend across Expedia/Hotels.com/Vrbo; trip elements (hotel night, rental night, flight, car day, cruise night, activity ticket) drive tiers Silver/Gold/Platinum; Member Prices 'Save 10% or more on thousands of hotels'; legacy Hotels.com stamps documented in Rewards T&Cs as convertible into OneKeyCash
interpretation: Monetization = commission-based OTA plus loyalty-driven retention; member price discount is a conversion lever surfaced directly in search filters.

observation: Third-party step-by-step guide documents web booking flow: home search wizard (destination, dates, guests, rooms) -> results (Featured default sort, sidebar filters, secret prices for signed-in users) -> property page (gallery, details, room list with Options column showing cancellation/prepayment policy, 'Let's Book') -> prepaid vs pay-on-arrival comparison modal ('Pay Now'/'Pay at Hotel') -> traveler details + payment + terms -> 'Book' confirmation
interpretation: Checkout is a multi-step wizard with an explicit rate-plan decision point (prepay vs pay-later). Corroborated by search-page filter 'paymentType'.
open_questions: Visual detail of checkout steps on current web build

observation: data-stid taxonomy observed: master-page, lodging-template-renderer, search-form-with-alternateDestination, EGDS* form fields (Location/RegionId/AirportCode/Lat/Long/DestinationId, DateRangePicker Start/End, Travelers Adult-1), search-results__main, desktop-sidebar, results-header, property-listing-results, lodging-card-responsive, outlined-save-button, open-hotel-information, destination-recs, onekeybanner-toggle, shared-ui-voice-of-the-customer
interpretation: Server-driven component model: screens are assembled from named slots/components (EGDS = Expedia Group Design System). Save ('outlined-save-button') is a per-card action feeding Trips.

observation: Image CDN images.trvl-media.com with impolicy=resizecrop&rw=&ra=fit transformation params; Google Maps static map API used on results page; error beacon www.hotels.com/cl/2x2.gif?action=logErrors; support hosted at service.hotels.com; partner listing at apps.expediapartnercentral.com; groups subdomain groups.hotels.com
interpretation: Shared Expedia Group media/CDN platform, Google Maps integration, pixel-based client error logging, and separate support/partner microsites.

observation: Maldives resort OTAs price packages as room + meal plan (BB/HB/FB/AI/Premium AI) + mandatory return transfer (speedboat/seaplane/domestic flight) + tax stack (TGST 17% + 10% service charge applied multiplicatively = 28.7% effective) + Green Tax ($6 or $12 per person per night by resort size); seaplane daylight-only constraint (06:00-16:00, last departures ~15:00) creates arrival-time booking rule; aggregators typically show room-only headline prices and add transfers at checkout
interpretation: A Maldives-only rebuild must model transfer logistics and meal plans as first-class pricing entities, unlike the generic Hotels.com room-rate model.
